name: Suspicious PowerShell Download
description: Detects suspicious PowerShell command lines used to download files.
author: Jules
query: process.name:powershell.exe AND process.command_line:(*Net.WebClient* OR *DownloadFile* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *iwr* OR *wget* OR *curl*) AND process.command_line:(*http\:* OR *https\:*)
